reviews.title: Excellent dinner
reviews.text:
Arrived this morning from the US and was staying nearby so we were happy to walk a block and to enjoy such an excellent meal.

Wait staff was friendly and helpful. We enjoyed the mushroom pasta dish which had great flavor and fresh pasta. The sauce was great. The chicken breast was perfectly cooked and came with tasty potatoes and green beans. 

The view faded quickly after sunset but a cool wind was blowing. It was nice to see they had blankets to offer. The setting was pretty on the ocean view but noisy and a huge loud mall on the other.

I would recommend dinner here!
